lines.speaker: Prelate-Assayer Quill
lines.text: The Sodality observes. It does not intervene. What this plant does today, it does under measurement.

lines.speaker: Rowen Corvane
lines.text: The bank is reading over line. Cells do not climb on their own. Somebody set them there.

lines.speaker: Nessa Kiln
lines.text: The bank is reading what it was told to read, officer. Licensed, metered, and signed for.

lines.speaker: Watch Sergeant
lines.text: Ma'am, our orders are the perimeter. Not the gallery.

lines.speaker: Nessa Kiln
lines.text: Interlock is off the rack. Clear the terrace.

lines.speaker: Rowen Corvane
lines.text: South walk is gone. Everyone off the ring — the hoists are dead, you go by the ramps or you stay up there.

lines.speaker: Prelate-Assayer Quill
lines.text: Four cells in series, and the grid browns out on cue. Accidents are not this tidy.

lines.speaker: Prelate-Assayer Quill
lines.text: The Inquiry will record this as a Combine act. I am recording what I saw. The two documents are not required to agree.

lines.speaker: Nessa Kiln
lines.text: Height buys you nothing here. The tower does not care which side of it you are standing on.

lines.speaker: Rowen Corvane
lines.text: It is not for seeing. It is the way to the board.
